fixes.title: Happy hour into steak night at Vinya Wine
fixes.theMove: Come off the beach for happy hour (4 to 6pm, Monday to Saturday) and stay for dinner. Order the corvina ceviche and Manchego croquetas, then the prime skirt steak with chimichurri. Pick any bottle from the shop shelves at retail plus a small corkage. The kitchen is closed Sunday.

tasteFlag: Secret 1 is honest: a residents' spot on the island, though it has an Infatuation 7.9 rating. 'Best low-key dinner' on the island is opinion; Infatuation's framing supports it.

reason: Open: the official Faena page lists bar service 10pm-3am and kitchen 10pm-12am, Thursday to Saturday, which matches the window and 'kitchen serves until midnight'. fixes.title: A late nightcap at Saxony Bar, the Faena's basement speakeasy
fixes.theMove: Dress up, reserve, and arrive soon after the 10pm opening on a Thursday to Saturday. Order a classic cocktail and stay for the DJ sets. The kitchen serves until midnight.
fixes.getIn: In the basement of the Faena Hotel. Book on SevenRooms or by email. Dress code is elegant chic: no sandals or beachwear. Valet available.
fixes.why: An intimate, golden-age-glamour speakeasy in the basement of Mid-Beach's most theatrical hotel, with DJs and old-school cocktails. Open only three nights a week, late.

tasteFlag: Secret 1 is borderline: it has a Time Out 5-star review and a 2026 Haute Living best-speakeasies listing, so 0 is defensible. The id still says 'late-jazz'; rename it if ids are user-visible.
